title: Tasks that need the skills together
statement: Teach and test the combined use of skills through whole tasks that truly need them together, defined by exemplars and a rubric, because passing every part doesn't show the whole.
example: Of 10 tasks written as integrative, the full gate certified 0, with 0 verified as integrative.
detail: The course-quality evaluator checked atomised item quality but not whether a unit contains tasks that coordinate several taught operations, and a gate of individually good atomised checks licenses "passed the parts," never "acquired the theme" (`ti-courseplans-audit/docs/handoffs-2026-07-13/course-eval-layer/evaluator-spec.md`). A capstone trial wrote 10 declared-integrative candidates against an unseen text and the full gate certified 0/10 (8 plain-blind leaks, 2 spine-conditioned leaks, 0 integrative verified), so nothing was published (the same file). The evaluator marked a checkpoint integrative because its bank held several skills, though the bank's own metadata declared all 15 serving tasks single-operation (`ti-courseplans-audit/docs/handoffs-2026-07-13/course-eval-layer/course-evidence-workbench.html`). The practice spec asks each theme checkpoint for at least 3 items integrative by construction, each needing two or more taught operations together, that test the combined move and never re-test the parts (`ti-courseplans-audit/docs/practice-layer-spec.md`). Passing every part doesn't show the whole, and calling a task integrative doesn't make it so.

4. **Decomposition floor.** Integrated performances (passage comprehension) stay whole as capstone KCs — exemplars + rubric-anchored outcome spaces, never sliced thinner.
the capstone KC should be treated as an integrative construct — defined by rich exemplars and rubric-anchored outcome spaces rather than an exhaustive list of component KCs.
A selected response can show one subdecision; it cannot silently stand in for the complete reading performance.
if a key is repeatedly recoverable without the text or a subdecision is used as a mastery verdict, the evidence claim is invalid.

5. **Integration is taught before it is assessed.** Learners do not automatically coordinate separately practiced parts. **Falsifier:** if an assessment combines moves that instruction never combined, the course has outsourced teaching to the assessment.
